title: StudyPage also lacks RequireCourseSelection wrapper
body: src/app/(frontend)/study/page.tsx renders StudyContent without RequireCourseSelection, relying on StudyContent's loadData() to redirect to /courses. This works but is inconsistent with the guard pattern. Consider adding RequireCourseSelection for consistency.
rationale: Both /study and /practice should follow the same guard pattern for grade-level-gated routes.
